Now we have functional group names: "aldehydes", "C-C double bonds". Use those.

Now search templates with criteria: molecule_smiles cinnamic acid, functional_groups_broken ["aldehydes"], functional_groups_formed ["C-C double bonds"], maybe also bonds_broken ["C=O"], bonds_formed ["C-C"], limit 10.

Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria.
